# Collateral Valuation and Credit Score Optimization Policy Review

This document addresses critical actions required regarding collateral valuation and borrower credit scores.

## Key Actions:

*   Investigate the collateral value based on audit findings.
*   Urgently update the collateral value.
*   Review the collateral value based on audit recommendations.
*   Monitor the collateral value on a quarterly basis.
*   Optimize the borrower credit score standard update process.
